label: Get the personalized content of a sent transactional email
description: <Note title="How to get uuid">You can get the uuid using either of the following methods: Send a GET request to https://api.brevo.com/v3/smtp/emails and pass the message_id in the url. Use your api-key to authenticate the request and you will get your uuid as a response. The uuid can also be fetched from the transactional logs page in your Brevo account, from the address URL.</Note>

uuid.description: Unique id of the transactional email that has been sent to a particular contact

attachmentCount.description: Count of the attachments that were sent in the email

body.description: Actual content of the transactional email that has been sent
body.example:
Greetings from the team

This is the actual html content sent

date.description: Date on which transactional email was sent

email.description: Email address to which transactional email has been sent

events.description: Series of events which occurred on the transactional email

name.description: Name of the event that occurred on the sent email

time.description: Time at which the event occurred
